notes.title: I Am Mouse - Presentation. Part One: Paths and Consequences
notes.content: [p]It's like a devlog, but it's not 😅  So, that's why I ended up calling it a presentation, even though I called it a devlog a few times in video. [/p][p]I Am Mouse offers different options and scenarios in some situations. It all depends on the player. Sometimes the player has to think, can I do this here? Or this? And try to do it. Experiment! [/p][p]The game offers this not only in plot moments, but also simply in secondary ones. Also, it's not all about influencing the ending of the game - no. It's just about what path the player will have on the way to the ending. [/p][p]Of course, the game is not always about freedom and choices. Sometimes the game will offer completely linear levels.[/p][previewyoutube="yspsfQI4t3o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🐭 Contact developer via mail: [url="https://ratstudioindie@gmail.com"]ratstudioindie@gmail.com[/url][/p][p]🐭 Follow me on: [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/ratstudios.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/RatStudioIndie"]X/Twitter[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/ratstudioindie/"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ratstudioindie"]TikTok [/url][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42168125/cfc83e58546b4a2ea38d9e721e68d4c37bcbe7d3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42168125/c3bb3a1d838e3241ea3dcf10b32aa0e323e693fe.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update №3
notes.content: [p][b]The following improvements and bug fixes have been made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slightly improved parkour system. It should now be easier to grab onto things (I'll continue to work on this);[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly improved camera behavior;[/p][/*][*][p]The game has been updated to have deeper gamepad support. Icons, menus, and so on will work with a gamepad if you play with it;[/p][/*][*][p]QTE was not displayed during the cat stage if a gamepad was connected to the PC[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance of music zones. Transitions sometimes occurred when they shouldn't have;[/p][/*][*][p]Final fix for a bug that sometimes caused not all letters to appear in animated text;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Iguana's ability to pull the player with its tongue;[/p][/*][*][p]You can hide behind obstacles from the Iguana's tongue;[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse Vision power recovery time was 30 seconds. Now 20;[/p][/*][*][p]If you take a stone, when it is highlighted by the power of Mouse Vision, it will shine endlessly;[/p][/*][*][p]Running takes less energy;[/p][/*][*][p]Edible grains sometimes did not disappear after being eaten;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some buggy flowers and bushes in Introduce Mode;[/p][/*][*][p]In Introduce Mode, after death, a checkpoint from Story Mode was loaded;[/p][/*][*][p]After loading a checkpoint, you could get to the cat's house if you completed the storyline there. This should not have happened - fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]A checkpoint preserves the location of objects that was moved;[/p][/*][*][p]Added some sound details to the location;[/p][/*][*][p]An action icon will appear above the item when you can actually pick it up;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with mice that give items. Sometimes they would disappear before the player could find them;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the energy interface. When drinking coffee, a visual effect should have been applied to it (if you had full energy);[/p][/*][*][p]Many graphical elements have been updated, both in the game itself and in the main menu;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased plant rendering distance;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the main character model on medium and lower settings;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hats and other customization items hanging in the air in cutscenes;[/p][/*][*][p]Customization items now show up in cutscenes;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the combat system. You could hold down W + LMB and fight endlessly;[/p][/*][*][p]And many other small fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your interest in the game![/p][p][b]If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It helps me a lot![/b][/p][p]                                                [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42168125/c3bb3a1d838e3241ea3dcf10b32aa0e323e693fe.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Slowfix
notes.content:
[p][b]Fixed achievements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Unsettling Rat;[/p][/*][*][p]Uninvited Guest;[/p][/*][*][p]Undying Feather;[/p][/*][*][p]What do you want?;[/p][/*][*][p]Whisker of Danger.[/p][/*][/list][p]Now you can get all the achievements![/p][p][/p][p][b]The following bugs have also been fixed:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Music during the battle with the raven disappeared; [/p][/*][*][p]The music sometimes turned off completely or was very quiet;[/p][/*][*][p]The music in the battle with the Iguana sometimes doesn't turn on;[/p][/*][*][p]The raven sometimes froze and couldn't walk;[/p][/*][*][p]After defeating the raven, the player was given two napkins to have a chance to survive the fall, but the UI did not update the napkin count;[/p][/*][*][p]If you enter the cat's house and then immediately leave, the music from the scene with the cat will remain;[/p][/*][*][p]The parachute sometimes disappeared (only visually);[/p][/*][*][p]New rocks (there a system that will spawn a new ones when there are few of them at a level) were not highlighted by the mouse's vision;[/p][/*][*][p]The battle with the iguana near the house is now easier. It regenerates less health, and more stones have been added.[/p][/*][/list][p]
I'm continuing to improve the demo. Thank you for your interest in the game![/p][p][b]If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It helps me a lot![/b][/p][p][/p][p]P.S. To all those who love achievements: sorry for the inconvenience![/p][p]And thanks to [b]DDtective[/b] for reporting the achievement issue.

notes.title: Long live the mouse!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42168125/0b6ae08ec7b81134dcfbcb993ccfb8b0474f956f.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

You might have noticed things have been a bit quiet from my end lately. That's because I've been pouring all my energy into preparing something special - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3684870/I_Am_Mouse_Demo_Adventure/]I Am Mouse: Demo Adventure[/url].

Get ready to dive in this summer! 
The demo will feature a large, replayable level packed with different ways to end level, Easter eggs, and fun secrets to uncover. 
Expect an adventure that can last anywhere from 30 minutes to several hours, depending on how deep you explore.

A massive thank you to everyone who has already wishlisted, followed, and supported I Am Mouse.
Your encouragement means the world!
If you haven't yet, please consider wishlisting the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421520/I_Am_Mouse/]I Am Mouse[/url] - it helps immensely!
More updates soon!

notes.title: Adjustment of development plans
notes.content:
Hello everybody! 

After talking to an experienced publisher, I decided to listen to advices.
Soo, I must say that at this time it was decided to abandon the cooperative.

Maybe I will return to the cooperative in the future. But now it has been decided to focus on the singleplayer experience.

I wish everyone a clear sky and a peaceful life!
